title: Factorized Hypothesis Search for Evidence-to-Taxonomy Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.06614v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large-taxonomy retrieval often assumes that the input already expresses the target concept. In many settings, however, the input is indirect evidence, such as a table cell whose meaning depends on its row, column, datatype, and context. We call this mismatch the retrieval readiness gap. Our analysis shows that the current index retrieves the target reliably when its semantics are explicit, while raw evidence often leaves it deep in the ranking. We propose Factorized Hypothesis Search (FHS), which maintains multiple partial interpretations over named semantic dimensions. These hypotheses support structured query rendering, multi-hypothesis retrieval, and dimension-level candidate verification. On both financial taxonomy tagging and CodiEsp clinical coding tasks, FHS achieves the best Recall@1, MRR, and final accuracy among the non-oracle methods. translated_title: 面向证据到分类体系检索的因子化假设搜索
translated_abstract: 大规模分类体系检索通常假设输入已经直接表达了目标概念。然而在许多场景下，输入只是间接证据，例如一个表格单元格，其含义依赖于所在的行、列、数据类型和上下文。我们将这种不匹配称为“检索就绪度差距”（retrieval readiness gap）。我们的分析表明，当目标语义显式时，现有索引能够可靠地检索到目标，而原始证据往往使目标排在很深的排名位置。我们提出因子化假设搜索（Factorized Hypothesis Search, FHS），它在多个命名的语义维度上维护多种部分解释。这些假设支持结构化查询渲染、多假设检索以及维度级别的候选验证。在金融分类标注和 CodiEsp 临床编码两项任务上，FHS 在非 oracle 方法中取得了最佳的 Recall@1、MRR 和最终准确率。用自由文本集成替换因子化假设路径会导致较大（的性能下降）。
tldr: 提出因子化假设搜索（FHS），通过在多个命名的语义维度上维护部分解释假设来弥合间接证据与目标概念之间的“检索就绪度差距”，在金融分类标注和临床编码任务上取得了非oracle方法中的最佳性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes Factorized Hypothesis Search (FHS), which maintains multiple partial interpretations across named semantic dimensions to bridge the retrieval readiness gap between indirect evidence and target concepts, achieving the best Recall@1, MRR, and final accuracy among non-oracle methods on financial taxonomy tagging and clinical coding tasks.
